faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCBS Facility Assistant (EM) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NCBS Facility Assistant (EM) post is 15 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Facility Assistant (EM) in NCBS?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Facility Assistant (EM) post in the National Centre for Biological Sciences recruitment drive for 2026. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NCBS Facility Assistant (EM) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NCBS Facility Assistant (EM) recruitment is online. Interested candidates must visit the official website and complete the application process electronically before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Facility Assistant (EM) position at NCBS?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Facility Assistant (EM) post should not be more than 35 years of age as of 15 September 2026. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for Facility Assistant (EM)?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold an M. Sc / M. Tech / Masters in any biological sciences discipline from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 55% of marks in aggregate to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NCBS Facility Assistant (EM) Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Facility Assistant (EM) post includes a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for final selection.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the NCBS Facility Assistant (EM) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Facility Assistant (EM) post at NCBS?
faq.answer: The salary for the Facility Assistant (EM) post will be as per Government norms, based on the candidate's experience and qualification. Specific details will be provided upon selection.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the job location be for the Facility Assistant (EM) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Facility Assistant (EM) position will be in Bangalore, Karnataka. NCBS is located in this city, making it the primary work location.

faq.question: Q10. How can I access the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by clicking the "Click here" link under "Official Notification PDF" in the Important Links section of this article. It contains all detailed information.
